column2: When asked to work another weekend, three engineers demurred, citing exhaustion.
column3: 被要求再加班一個週末時，三名工程師以疲憊為由表示異議。
column4: demur at the request (對要求表示異議)
column5: de 離開 + mur 拖延（拉丁 morari）：遲疑著不肯動

column2: The desert wind desiccated the fruit left on the cart until it was hard as stone.
column3: 沙漠的風把留在推車上的水果吹到乾透，硬得像石頭。
column5: de 完全 + sicc 乾（拉丁 siccus）：水分被抽得精光

column2: Critics reject the dichotomy between work and play, arguing that good teaching blends the two.
column3: 批評者拒絕工作與遊戲的二分法，主張好的教學是兩者的融合。
column5: di 二 + tom 切（atom 原子本指不可切）：一刀切成兩半

column2: The dilatory contractor kept promising to finish the roof but never brought his tools.
column3: 拖拉的承包商一直保證會完成屋頂，卻連工具都沒帶來過。
column5: 長得像 delay 延遲：一直拖、慢吞吞

column2: A dilettante in every field, he dabbled in painting, then violin, then pottery, finishing nothing.
column3: 他在每個領域都只是玩票，先畫畫、再拉小提琴、再做陶藝，卻什麼都沒完成。
column5: 源自義大利文「玩得開心」：樣樣淺嚐，不求精通

column2: The mentor gently disabused her of the notion that talent alone guarantees success.
column3: 導師溫和地糾正她認為光靠天分就能保證成功的想法。
column4: disabuse someone of (使某人醒悟而放棄)
column5: dis 去除 + abuse 欺騙：把被騙的想法去掉

column2: A discerning collector, she could tell a genuine antique from a clever copy in seconds.
column3: 她是眼光敏銳的收藏家，幾秒內就能分辨真古董與巧妙的仿品。
column5: dis 分開 + cern 篩（concern）：把好壞篩得清清楚楚

column2: The tough question visibly discomfited the candidate, who stammered and glanced at his notes.
column3: 這個棘手的問題明顯讓候選人狼狽不堪，他結結巴巴地瞄向筆記。
column5: dis 不 + comfort 舒適：讓人坐立難安、尷尬

column2: The violin sounded discordant against the piano, as if the two were in different keys.
column3: 小提琴和鋼琴聽起來不和諧，彷彿兩者的調子不同。
column5: dis 分開 + cord 弦、心：各彈各的，聲音合不攏

column2: The leaked emails were meant to discredit the mayor before the election.
column3: 洩漏的電子郵件意在選舉前讓市長名譽掃地。
column4: discredit a theory (使理論失去可信度)
column5: dis 不 + credit 信用：讓人不再信任

column2: The survey divides respondents into five discrete groups that do not overlap.
column3: 這項調查把受訪者分成五個互不重疊的獨立群組。
column5: 別和 discreet 謹慎混淆：discrete 的兩個 e 被 t 隔開

column2: The manager has the discretion to approve small refunds without asking headquarters.
column3: 經理有權自行決定批准小額退款，不必請示總部。
column4: at your discretion (由你自行決定)
column5: discreet 謹慎的名詞：謹慎判斷後，自己拿主意

column2: His disjointed answer jumped from topic to topic and left the panel confused.
column3: 他支離破碎的回答在各個主題之間跳來跳去，讓評審團一頭霧水。
column5: dis 分開 + joint 關節：關節脫開，接不起來

column2: She was dismissive of the intern's idea and waved it away without reading it.
column3: 她對實習生的想法不屑一顧，連看都沒看就揮手打發。
column4: dismissive of criticism (對批評不屑一顧)
column5: dismiss 打發走 + ive：習慣揮揮手把人趕開

column2: A dispassionate judge, she weighed the facts without letting sympathy sway her.
column3: 她是冷靜客觀的法官，衡量事實，不讓同情左右判斷。
column5: dis 無 + passion 熱情：把情緒放一邊

column2: Her cheerful disposition made her popular with patients and staff alike.
column3: 她開朗的性情，讓她同時受到病患與同事的喜愛。
column5: dispose 安排：天生被安排好的個性傾向

column2: The scandal brought the once-proud club into disrepute.
column3: 這樁醜聞使這個曾經風光的俱樂部名譽掃地。
column5: dis 不 + repute 名聲：好名聲不見了

column2: He dissembled his disappointment behind a polite smile when the prize went to another.
column3: 獎項被別人拿走時，他在禮貌的微笑後掩飾了失望。
column5: dis + semble（resemble 相似）：裝成另一個樣子

column2: Volunteers disseminate flu-prevention leaflets in subway stations every autumn.
column3: 志工每年秋天都在捷運站發送預防流感的傳單。
column5: dis 四處 + semin 種子（seminar）：像四處撒種子

column2: Two justices dissented from the ruling and wrote their own opinion.
column3: 兩名大法官對這項裁決持異議，並另寫自己的意見書。
column4: dissent from the ruling (對裁決持異議)
column5: dis 分開 + sent 感覺（consent 同意）：感覺不一樣

column2: The dissonance between his words and his actions made voters doubt him.
column3: 他言行之間的矛盾，讓選民對他起了疑心。
column5: dis 不 + son 聲音（sonic）：聲音不合，刺耳又矛盾

column2: Gas from the fermenting dough caused the bag to distend like a balloon.
column3: 發酵麵糰產生的氣體，使袋子像氣球般膨脹起來。
column5: dis 向外 + tend 伸（extend）：向外撐開

column2: The author distilled ten years of research into a single clear essay.
column3: 作者把十年的研究精煉成一篇清晰的文章。
column5: 想像蒸餾器一滴一滴落下，只留最純的精華

column2: The divisive debate over school uniforms split parents into two angry camps.
column3: 關於校服的爭議性辯論，把家長分成兩個憤怒的陣營。
column5: divide 分開 + ive：專把人分成兩邊

column2: The lawyer refused to divulge what her client had told her in confidence.
column3: 律師拒絕透露當事人私下告訴她的內容。
column5: di 散開 + vulg 大眾（vulgar）：讓祕密流到大眾耳裡

column2: After the speech was edited, the dross was gone and only the key arguments remained.
column3: 講稿經過編修後，糟粕全消失了，只剩關鍵論點。
column4: sift out the dross (篩掉廢料)
column5: 想像煉金屬時，浮在表面的黑渣要撈掉

column2: Her eclectic playlist mixes jazz, folk, opera, and electronic dance music.
column3: 她兼收並蓄的歌單混合了爵士、民謠、歌劇與電子舞曲。
column5: ec 出 + lect 選（select 挑選）：從各家挑出精華

column2: Clinical trials confirmed the efficacy of the new vaccine against severe illness.
column3: 臨床試驗證實了這款新疫苗預防重症的功效。
column4: efficacy of a drug (藥物的療效)
column5: effic 做出（effect 效果、efficient 有效率）：真的做得出效果

column2: He had the effrontery to ask for a raise on the day he was caught napping.
column3: 他在被抓到打瞌睡的那天，居然還厚著臉皮要求加薪。
column5: ef 出 + front 額頭（forehead）：把臉皮大剌剌亮出來

column2: The teacher's open question elicited a surprising range of answers from the quiet class.
column3: 老師的開放式問題，從安靜的班上引出了出乎意料的各種答案。
column5: e 出 + lic 引誘（lure）：把答案誘出來

column2: She spoke in an emollient tone that eased the tension in the meeting.
column3: 她用安撫的語氣說話，緩和了會議上的緊繃氣氛。
column5: e 出 + moll 軟（mollify 安撫）：讓硬邦邦的變軟

column2: Unfair grading can engender resentment among students.
column3: 不公平的評分可能在學生之間引發怨恨。
column5: en 使 + gender 生出（generate 產生）：讓它誕生

column2: She accepted the bad news with equanimity and calmly began to plan the next step.
column3: 她平靜地接受了壞消息，並冷靜地開始規劃下一步。
column5: equ 平（equal）+ anim 心（animal）：心像水面一樣平

column2: Calling a layoff "a workforce adjustment" is a classic euphemism.
column3: 把裁員稱為「人力調整」是典型的委婉說法。
column4: a polite euphemism (客氣的委婉語)
column5: eu 好 + phem 說話：把難聽的事說得好聽

column2: The restaurant's execrable service drove away even its most loyal customers.
column3: 這家餐廳糟透了的服務，連最忠實的老顧客都被趕跑。
column5: ex 像打叉 X：壞到要被畫叉叉、人人嫌棄

column2: Exigent circumstances allowed the officers to enter the burning building without a warrant.
column3: 緊急情況讓警員得以不經令狀進入起火的建築物。
column5: ex 出 + ig 驅動（agent）：事情逼著人立刻行動

column2: The professor expatiated on the history of the telescope for nearly an hour.
column3: 教授花了將近一小時詳細闡述望遠鏡的歷史。
column4: expatiate on a topic (詳述某主題)
column5: ex 出 + spati 空間（space）：話鋪展到很大的空間，滔滔不絕

column2: The expatriate teacher missed her family but loved her new life in Taipei.
column3: 這位旅居海外的老師想念家人，卻愛上她在台北的新生活。
column5: ex 外 + patri 祖國（patriot 愛國者）：離開祖國的人

column2: She is a leading exponent of renewable energy and speaks at conferences worldwide.
column3: 她是再生能源的主要倡導者，在世界各地的研討會演講。
column4: leading exponent of (…的主要倡導者)
column5: ex 出 + pon 放（position 位置）：把主張擺出來宣傳

column2: Censors expurgated the novel, cutting every passage they judged unsuitable for schools.
column3: 審查人員刪改了這本小說，刪去所有他們認為不適合學校的段落。
column5: ex 出 + purg 清洗（purify 淨化）：把不乾淨的洗掉
